hook.en: When onion prices jump, farmers cannot grow more overnight, but a T-shirt factory can run an extra shift. Elasticity of supply measures this response.
hook.kn: ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ ಬೆಲೆ ಏರಿದಾಗ ರೈತರು ರಾತ್ರೋರಾತ್ರಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೆಳೆಯಲಾರರು; ಆದರೆ ಟಿ-ಶರ್ಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಪಾಳಿ ನಡೆಸಬಹುದು. ಈ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಕೆಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವ ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Define and calculate price elasticity of supply
Use the geometric method for straight-line supply curves

narration.en: When onion prices jump, farmers cannot grow more overnight, but a T-shirt factory can run an extra shift. Elasticity of supply measures this response.
narration.kn: ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ ಬೆಲೆ ಏರಿದಾಗ ರೈತರು ರಾತ್ರೋರಾತ್ರಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೆಳೆಯಲಾರರು; ಆದರೆ ಟಿ-ಶರ್ಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಪಾಳಿ ನಡೆಸಬಹುದು. ಈ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಕೆಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವ ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Price elasticity of supply measures the responsiveness of quantity supplied to a change in price: $e_S = \dfrac{\%\ \text{change in quantity supplied}}{\%\ \text{change in price}} = \dfrac{\Delta q}{\Delta p}\times\dfrac{p}{q}$. It is positive because supply curves slope upward. $e_S > 1$: elastic; $e_S < 1$: inelastic; $e_S = 1$: unitary; $e_S = 0$: perfectly inelastic (vertical); $e_S = \infty$: perfectly elastic (horizontal).

narration.en: Price elasticity of supply is the percentage change in quantity supplied divided by the percentage change in price. It is positive.
narration.kn: ಪೂರೈಕೆಯ ಬೆಲೆ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವ = ಪೂರೈಕೆ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದ ಶೇಕಡಾ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ÷ ಬೆಲೆಯ ಶೇಕಡಾ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ. ಇದು ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ.

say.en: Percentage method: price rises from 10 to 12 and quantity from 200 to 250.
Geometric rule for straight lines. A line through the origin has elasticity exactly one at every point.
A line meeting the price axis above the origin is elastic. A line meeting the quantity axis is inelastic.

title.en: Price elasticity along a supply line

caption.en: A straight supply line q = 2(p − a). If it starts on the price axis (a > 0), supply is elastic (eS > 1); through the origin (a = 0), eS = 1 everywhere; from the quantity axis (a < 0), it is inelastic (eS < 1). Move a and the price and read eS = (Δq/Δp) × (p/q).
caption.kn: ಸರಳ ಪೂರೈಕೆ ರೇಖೆ q = 2(p − a). ಬೆಲೆ ಅಕ್ಷದಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾದರೆ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ (eS > 1); ಮೂಲದ ಮೂಲಕ eS = 1; ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಅಕ್ಷದಿಂದ ಅಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ (eS < 1).

body.en: For a straight-line supply curve: if it passes through the origin, $e_S = 1$ at every point; if it meets the price axis at a positive price, $e_S > 1$; if it meets the quantity axis at a positive quantity, $e_S < 1$. Supply is more elastic when producers have more time to adjust, when there is spare capacity, when inputs are easy to get and when the good can be stored. Perishable farm goods in the very short run have inelastic supply.

narration.en: A straight-line supply curve through the origin has elasticity one. Time to adjust, spare capacity and easy inputs make supply more elastic.
narration.kn: ಮೂಲಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಾದುಹೋಗುವ ನೇರ ಪೂರೈಕೆ ರೇಖೆಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವ ಒಂದು. ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಗೆ ಸಮಯ, ಬಿಡುವಿನ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸುಲಭ ಆದಾನಗಳು ಪೂರೈಕೆಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: The price of a good rises from ₹10 to ₹12 and quantity supplied rises from 200 to 250 units. Find the price elasticity of supply. What is eS for q = 10 + 2p at p = ₹5?

steps.en: For q = 10 + 2p at p = 5: q = 20; eS = 2 × 5/20 = 0.5: inelastic (line meets the quantity axis).

answer.en: eS = 1.25 in the first case; eS = 0.5 for q = 10 + 2p at p = ₹5.

explanation.en: eS = (%Δq)/(%Δp) = 2 with a 20% price rise needs a 40% rise in quantity: 280 units.

homework.en: Draw three straight-line supply curves showing eS = 1, eS > 1 and eS < 1.

narration.en: Recap. eS = %Δq ÷ %Δp, and it is positive. Straight line through origin: eS = 1. Price-axis intercept: eS > 1; quantity-axis intercept: eS < 1. More time to adjust makes supply more elastic.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪೂರೈಕೆ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವ = %Δq ÷ %Δp; ಇದು ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ. ಮೂಲಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಾದುಹೋಗುವ ನೇರ ರೇಖೆ: eS = 1. ಬೆಲೆ ಅಕ್ಷ ಛೇದ: eS > 1; ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಅಕ್ಷ ಛೇದ: eS < 1. ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಮಯವಿದ್ದರೆ ಪೂರೈಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ.
